'''''Stargazer''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] used to promote<ref name="Lethal" /> the musical act<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lightsaber-lost-trivia-gallery|text="Lightsaber Lost" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref> of the same name on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ad came in the form of billboards<ref name="Duchess">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> and regular posters, which were put up around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Lethal" /> Both the billboards<ref name="Duchess" /> and the posters showed a silhouette of a cheering audience,<ref name="Lethal" /> although the billboard version featured a different [[Color/Legends|color]] palette, and a portion on the left hand side of the motif was missing.<ref name="Duchess" /> The name "[[Stargazer/Legends|STARGAZER]]" was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] script at the bottom.<ref name="Lethal" />

The poster appeared in a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]] in the area known as [[Slum district G17/Legends|Slum District G17]],<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]],<ref name="Lethal" /> an alley in the [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]],<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref> and the [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]] at [[79's/Legends|79's]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] bar.<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref> The billboard version could be seen in a [[Galactic City/Legends|city]] street when a [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|Death Watch assassin]] attacked and threw a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] at [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]].<ref name="Duchess" />
